name: Silk Queen
shortDescription: The next mouth after the hatchling. She waits for three.
lookDescription: A larger silk-shape fills the split cradle. She does not roar. She waits for three.
examineDescription: The Silk Queen is the next mouth after the hatchling. She is not Holm. Longer legs. Thicker silk. Threads tighten when a Collegian locks a move. The hum counts three. Alder would not send one Collegian for this. If she squares up, lock together. When she falls, she stays fallen.
victoryNarration: The Silk Queen folds in on herself. The hum in the floor misses a beat, then goes on without her.
